column1: # Authorization policy: who may get past the role gate of each /v1 endpoint.
# A = gets past the role gate (reaches validation or the handler), D = denied (401/403).
# A is not "may use it": handlers still refuse after looking up the record — a student
# reading a payment, staff creating a remark request, anyone touching another family's
# records. Those checks are proven with real records in 05-object-access.test.ts.
# Reviewed in the security audit of 27 Sep 2026 (.audit/security-audit.tsv).
# 04-authz-matrix.test.ts fails if an endpoint is added without a row here,
# or if any principal is let through or turned away against its row.
# F0a (FEATURES_PLAN.md): the academic structure, the student record, settings, the
# teacher capability, uploads by purpose, eligibility, series correction, teacher links.
# F0b (FEATURES_PLAN.md): the exam catalogue, board series, the series a window feeds,
# course enrolment. The entry deadline (MO-10) is the admin's: PUT /v1/board-series/:id refuses
# a coordinator who changes it (08h). A family reads only its own child's enrolment (05).
# F4 (FEATURES_PLAN.md; docs/features/EXAM_ENTRIES.md §6): exam-entry management is the
# coordinator's and the admin's. The national ID (/candidates/:studentId/identity) is theirs alone.
# A teacher reaches forecasts, their duties and registers (the handler checks teacherOf and the
# invigilated room: 05). A family reads its own child's /students/:studentId/* (05); the desk
# reads any student's and hands certificates over. The gate reaches nothing here.
# the session's links sheet (offers, teachers, items) is the admin's and the coordinator's; the
# Money tab the admin's and finance's; the grade-10 bulk the admin's and the coordinator's; the fee
# grids the admin's and the finance admin's (the coordinator reads them); a student's offers the
# student, a linked parent and staff with student records (the handler checks which student).
# The reservations rework, step C (docs/features/RESERVATIONS_MONEY.md §5): charges, board services, the registry, the desk-drop, the push.
# The reservations rework, step D (docs/features/RESERVATIONS_MESSAGES.md §3): messages and reminders. They replace the admin's
# /v1/notifications/admin/announce and /admin/scheduled (removed). Finance passes the gate; the service lets it send to and read the
# money lists only (05-object-access.test.ts and 08s prove the refusals). Families have no row here: they read /v1/notifications.
